page.layout: One column of running text, filling the page. Page number 677 at the top right. No margin notes, no running head, catchword or signature.

main_text.p: dis, vel etiam fuscipiendis observabat: cum tamen aliis ritibus, moribus, atque institutis Romana uteretur, a suffocatis abstinebat, Grana aquæ calidæ in confecrato calice admiscebat, Ieiunium præcipue quadrage-simale, & alia rigidissime celebrabat, sa-cram Eucharistiam infantibus statim etiam a Baptismate porrigebat, sub utraque spe-cie communicabat, Clerogamiam admittebat, Symbolum[?] abfque additione recita-bat[?], aliter divinum pensum exoluebat, aliter divinas preces recitabat, ante sacros ordines Lectores tantum Clericos, non item Ostiarios, non Exorcistas, non Acolythos, in peruigiliis Apostolorum ieiunium non fuscipiebat, matrimonio adstrictos ad ordines promouebat, Sabbato non abstinebat a carnibus; cum Latina Ecclesia abstineret, matrimonio adstrictos non promoueret ad ordines, in peruigiliis Apostolorum ieiunaret, Clericos ordinaret ad quatuor ordines minores, aliter divinas preces recitaret, aliter divinum pensum exolueret, Symbolum cum additione recitaret, Clerogamiam prohiberet, sub unica tantum specie Azymo communicaret, infantibus communionem denegaret, ieiunia veluti Græca non celebraret, aquam calidam in confecrato calice non immiscerct, a suffocatis non abstineret,

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Symbo!um" (the fifth letter looks like an l damaged by the scan, read as Symbolum[?]); "rcecitabat" (the first letters are smudged, read as recitabat[?]). Original printing: "suscipiendis" printed with long s; "alijs" and "peruigilijs" printed with j as a vowel; "atq;" kept as printed. The line ends "abfti-" / "neret," and "cele-" / "braret," were hyphenated in print and are kept. The fragment "dis," at the top is a continuation of the previous page's sentence.
